swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS610994DRVR uses WSON-6 (6-pin, DRV) while TPS63001DRCR uses VSON-10 (10-pin, DRC); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs SW), Pin 3 (FB vs GND), Pin 4 (EN vs SW), Pin 5 (SW vs VIN), Pin 6 (VIN vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs PS), Pin 8 (NONE vs VIN), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB). Soldering TPS63001DRCR onto a TPS610994DRVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

CRITICAL TOPOLOGY DIFFERENCE: TPS610994DRVR is a boost converter whereas TPS63001DRCR is a buck-boost converter; power-stage architecture, inductor placement, and startup behavior differ fundamentally.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS610994DRVR specifies 1000 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS63001DRCR 1200 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 35% (TPS610994DRVR: 71.7 °C/W p.4 vs TPS63001DRCR: 46.8 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS610994DRVR (Texas Instruments, WSON-6) and TPS63001DRCR (Texas Instruments, VSON-10) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (GND vs VOUT), Pin 2 (VOUT vs SW), Pin 3 (FB vs GND), Pin 4 (EN vs SW), Pin 5 (SW vs VIN), Pin 6 (VIN vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs PS), Pin 8 (NONE vs VIN), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB). Key datasheet deltas: topology is boost (sync) vs buck-boost (sync), switching frequency is 1116 kHz (p.16) vs 1500 kHz (p.5), rated current is 1000 mA (p.5) vs 1200 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 2.2 µH (p.4) vs 2.2 µH (p.1), and Iq is 1 µA (p.5) vs 41 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 71.7 vs 46.8 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
